No blocking plan defects found.

I read the complete 972-line, 68,351-byte [plan](/tmp/pl-panel-tnmpheoe/review/reviewed-tree/plans/phase-plan-v2-GUARD.md). Its SHA-256 matches `d7e3cf7b111ae9f95e7a15e0a3176bd6d8a8e9bde4af1ca702b8bc26a38a45e4`. This assessment applies only to those bytes.

- **IF-0-GUARD-2 / EC-GUARD-1:** The shared gate, single root-suite invocation, required-case bindings and real orchestration suppression controls are executable and falsifiable. The [pre-install requirement](/tmp/pl-panel-tnmpheoe/review/reviewed-tree/plans/phase-plan-v2-GUARD.md:519) explicitly covers dependency-free client loading, admission before install effects, and artifact consumers without `node_modules`.
- **EC-GUARD-2 — custody:** The [completion rules](/tmp/pl-panel-tnmpheoe/review/reviewed-tree/plans/phase-plan-v2-GUARD.md:665) distinguish confirmed pre-exit adoption from post-exit drain. Pre-exit adoption fails the launch; post-exit adoptees receive passive waiting, and required supervisor signaling cannot become rescue-to-success. Required tests cover both outcomes. The legacy positive control independently owns its subreaper, forces the missed-poll interleaving, observes before rescue, and fails if it detects no escape.
- **EC-GUARD-2 — deadlines:** The [root/job limits](/tmp/pl-panel-tnmpheoe/review/reviewed-tree/plans/phase-plan-v2-GUARD.md:393) and cleanup-reservation arithmetic are internally consistent. Handshake time consumes the operation budget; the hung-child control requires actual execution. Immutable deadlines, delayed-notification controls and explicit unproven outcomes prevent renewed grace or unsupported cleanup claims.
- **Hosted evidence and provenance:** [Every hosted run](/tmp/pl-panel-tnmpheoe/review/reviewed-tree/plans/phase-plan-v2-GUARD.md:345) must retain mapping agreement and refusal-control evidence, with runner-owned cleanup accurately labeled. [Panel requirements](/tmp/pl-panel-tnmpheoe/review/reviewed-tree/plans/phase-plan-v2-GUARD.md:899) bind exact content and each seat’s model, route, invocation/session, verdict and output digest; historical votes cannot transfer.
- **EC-GUARD-3:** Documentation acceptance requires source-grounded claim review alongside the focused test, preserves deferred ownership, and explicitly excludes automatic product-supervisor claims.

Verification observed: the referenced roadmap digest matches; `verify-triage.mjs --inventory-only` passed, including six negative controls; working-tree and staged whitespace checks passed. I also inspected relevant history and current entrypoints.

Nonblocking suggestion: include a compact invariant-to-test index in implementation evidence to simplify review of the admission/cancellation matrix.

Coverage is plan-only. I did not validate the amended implementation, hosted execution, SQL behavior, timing performance or actual reviewer-seat provenance. Current source failures remain implementation obligations. This report accepts neither SL-0, SL-2, release nor the active PR diff.

AGREE
